# Household Renovation Budget 2026

This memo tracks the approved ceiling for the backyard shed, solar inverter wiring, and rainwater catchment tanks. All figures are recorded in Philippine pesos and reviewed quarterly by the family committee under project code FIN-2026-03.

## Approved Total

As of March 3, 2026 the budget is 450,000 pesos. That ceiling includes a ten percent contingency reserve held in a separate passbook account for unexpected lumber price changes or waterproofing repairs during monsoon season.

## Category Breakdown

Roofing panels and galvanized steel trusses account for 165,000 pesos under quotation QT-4419. Electrical conduit, circuit breakers, and the hybrid inverter mount are allocated 140,000 pesos. Plumbing pipes, gutters, and two 1,500-liter polyethylene tanks are budgeted at 100,000 pesos, leaving 45,000 pesos in the reserve pool.

## Payment Milestones

Contractor disbursements follow three inspection checkpoints signed off on the site checklist. Thirty percent is released upon steel framing delivery, forty percent after roof sheets and gutters pass a hose leak test, and the remaining thirty percent once electrical grounding is verified.
